instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or extended in front of you.
2. Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
3. Raise up a few cm, then lower back to the parallel position in a small pulse.
4. Keep pulsing in the lower range with control.
5. Stand back up to the starting position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your feet flat and weight over your midfoot for balance.
2. Keep your chest up and avoid leaning too far forward.
3. Push your knees out in line with your toes during each pulse.
4. Move slowly to keep tension on the legs.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
2. Step your right foot back and lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee is just above the ground.
3. Keep your front knee stacked over your ankle.
4. Push through your front heel to return to standing.
5. Repeat with the left foot stepping back, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright throughout the movement.
2. Lower your back knee straight down rather than reaching forward.
3. Drive through the front heel to stand up.
4. Move with control to keep your balance.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
2. Step your right foot back and lower into a lunge while raising both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
3. Keep your front knee stacked over your ankle and your back knee just above the ground.
4. Push through your front heel to stand up while lowering your arms.
5. Repeat with the left foot stepping back, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Inhale as you lunge down and exhale as you stand up.
2. Keep your arms straight and stop the raise at shoulder height.
3. Keep your torso upright as you lower.
4. Drive through the front heel to return to standing.

instructions:
1. Stand on your right leg with a slight bend in the knee and your hands by your sides.
2. Hinge at the hip and lean your torso forward while lifting your left leg straight behind you.
3. Keep your back flat and lower until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
4. Drive through your right heel and squeeze your glute to return to standing.
5. Finish the set, then switch to the left leg.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips level and avoid twisting the torso.
2. Move slowly to stay balanced on the standing leg.
3. Fix your eyes on a point ahead to help with balance.
4. Keep a slight bend in the standing knee throughout.
